name: Radix UI
summary: Unstyled accessible React primitives with interactive docs demos and a unified npm package.
gaps: Headless/unstyled — demos require consumer CSS; docs anatomy/examples are copyable.
Pilot includes 12 primitives — Themes (styled) layer exists separately; this ingest is Primitives-only.
Kept under P2 headless KEEP rule (public docs → interactive demos + copyable install/code ≥8).
Unified package is `radix-ui`; legacy `@radix-ui/react-*` packages still exist.
iframe demos only; no dynamic-import smoke mounts in this packet.

components.name: Dialog

demo.peerNotes: Headless MIT primitives (WorkOS). Style yourself. Docs page hosts live interactive demo + copyable anatomy/examples. Unified `radix-ui` package.

components.copyCode:
npm install radix-ui@latest

import { Dialog } from "radix-ui";

export default () => (
  <Dialog.Root>
    <Dialog.Trigger>Open</Dialog.Trigger>
    <Dialog.Portal>
      <Dialog.Overlay />
      <Dialog.Content>
        <Dialog.Title>Edit profile</Dialog.Title>
        <Dialog.Description>Make changes to your profile here.</Dialog.Description>
        <Dialog.Close>Close</Dialog.Close>
      </Dialog.Content>
    </Dialog.Portal>
  </Dialog.Root>
);
